title: The categorical local Langlands conjecture
summary: We formulate a program to prove the categorical local Langlands conjecture (CLLC) of Fargues-Scholze, for all quasisplit $p$-adic groups where the Fargues-Scholze $L$-parameters agree with the semisimplification of a known "automorphic" local Langlands parametrization. A key working hypothesis - which we expect to prove elsewhere jointly with Hamann - is the compatibility of the enhanced Whittaker coefficient functor $c_ψ$ with Eisenstein series.
